$description: Synapse design tokens. Byte-faithful mirror of the poppin @theme block (poppin/src/styles/globals.css), the Synapse 5 system redlined off the 'Poppin web app' Figma. Token names are poppin's own so the generated theme.css is drop-in for poppin itself. Nothing here is invented: every value and name exists in poppin. State rules, borders, motion and component recipes live in ../recipes/synapse-web.md (also extracted from poppin, never invented). Cards sit DARKER than the canvas; depth comes from surface contrast.

canvas.$description: App background (index.html theme-color uses it too).

surface.$description: Cards and panels. Darker than canvas by design.

surface-active.$description: Selected or hovered rows (Select options use hover:bg-surface-active).

razer-green.$description: The green. CTAs, active states, selected rings (razer-green/50), current Select option.

off-white.$description: Soft text: subtitles, quiet labels, inactive tag dots. Grey scale is white -> off-white -> grey -> white/40 placeholders; #D6D6D6 does not exist (Boris-confirmed).

grey.$description: Muted text: idle nav items, secondary info, the SOON tag label.

ink-soft.$description: Dark label on green CTAs, per the official button SVGs.

danger.$description: Error banner red. Eyeballed off the mockup in poppin, pending the exact Figma value.

display.$description: Headings, nav, buttons, labels. Body text color is plain white, set on body.

body.$description: Body copy, profile-card names, state pills.

unit.$description: Literal 4px step: p-1 4, p-2 8, p-3 12, p-4 16, p-6 24, p-8 32. Two sanctioned off-grid values in poppin: the 10px search icon gap and the 146px page gutter, kept arbitrary at their use sites.

sm.$description: Button, Input, Select, hero chips, SOON tag.

lg.$description: Status chips, tile covers, editor panels, profile cards.

2xl.$description: List rows, banners, the DbR accordion panel.

tabs.$description: The Add source switcher bar, the one off-grid radius.

eyebrow.$description: Single tracking for uppercase eyebrows and micro-labels.
